title: Pet Left the Safe Zone Alert
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections.
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tractive:position
| eval outside=if(in_safe_zone="false",1,0)
| where outside=1
| stats min(_time) as left_at, latest(latitude) as lat, latest(longitude) as lon by pet_name
| eval left_at=strftime(left_at,"%F %T")
description: Fires the moment a pet's GPS tracker reports it has left your defined safe zone, so an escaped dog or wandering cat is caught early.
value: The first minutes of an escape matter most; an instant geofence alert with a location can turn a frantic search into a quick recovery.
implementation: Ingest pet GPS positions and geofence state; schedule at the shortest interval and send a high-priority alert on any breach.
visualization: Map and alert panel showing the pet's location when it left the safe zone.
grandmaExplanation: It alerts you the instant your pet wanders out of the safe area, with a map so you can go straight to them.
